verdict.rationale: Cerebras ships first-party SDKs. The quickstart installs a Python package (`cerebras_cloud_sdk`), and an official Node/TypeScript SDK lives in the Cerebras GitHub org with SDK-specific behavior such as TCP warming. OpenAI API compatibility also lets existing OpenAI clients work with only a key, base URL and model change. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation beyond install and README snippets, evidence of SDKs in other languages, and independent hands-on corroboration of the official SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: This library provides convenient access to the Cerebras REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
This SDK has a mechanism that sends a few requests to `/v1/tcp_warming` upon construction to reduce the TTFT.
Existing applications can use Cerebras by changing the API key, base URL, and model ID.
